Root-caused at the gate. the harness still pointed at the preview slug after a failed command chain, and the streamed redirect drops query strings, both fixed. Remaining owner action, apply migration 008 in the Supabase SQL editor to open the wall.

Owner verdict on v1, feels AI and gimmicky, like a kids game, confusing without context, remove the TTS voice, needs museum-grade education. Council diagnosis, the AI feeling is epistemological, simulations standing where real documents exist. Rebuild plan, one reader-paced experience (no audio, no modes, no auto-advance), delete the meta-game layer (medallion collectibles, machine board HUD, DECLINED tap game, press-and-hold, count-ups, gear train, answer key game, machine cards), rewrite all text as historian wall text per humanizer rules, keep only evidence-forward stations (real HOLC map with real surveyor sheets, bombing record, Two Buyers arithmetic, wealth gap scale, annotated real documents), add the Surveyor's Files reading room (576 real descriptions, permalinks), an opening context panel in plain words, and an About this exhibit authorship panel with the registry as bibliography. No visual-system redesign. Fact registry, HOLC data, and harness untouched as infrastructure.

decisions.title: R7 graphical overhaul, council-directed
decisions.decision: Owner asked for a graphically led pass with 3D ambition. Full LLM council (5 advisors, anonymized peer review, chairman) shaped the build. Shipped: (1) the 1940 map as an SVG relief, every area extruded by a quantized step per grade with an explicit rank-not-measurement disclosure, a 7-stop native-slider turn handle (no drag, never fights scroll), flat study map one tap away, relief default in ch0 and flat in ch6; SVG over WebGL so all 703 areas stay keyboard-operable DOM buttons and the a11y suite sees everything. (2) The four covenant cases redrawn as one red current rerouting around two ink barriers (CasesFlow), one detail card, replacing four identical stacked cards. (3) ch11 ledger table replaced by a vertical record timeline with machinery-era years in red. (4) Archival figure pass: 1851 Rees plat (ch1), University Apartments + 63rd Street Woodlawn 1973 (ch8), 22nd/State newsstand 1973 (ch10); captions verified against NARA/LOC records. (5) Retention: stated reading time, chapter position on the mobile chip, find-the-ground link at the top.
decisions.alternativesRejected: Geological strata timeline killed (scroll-inversion caught twice; geology naturalizes an engineered process). Four-doors metaphor killed (illustration standing in for editing). Parallax photo mounts killed unanimously. WebGL terrain deferred (SVG met the bar; parallel-DOM and iOS risks avoided). Extrusion by continuous magnitude rejected for v1 (grade is ordinal; stepped tiers labeled as rank are the honest encoding; real-magnitude extrusion possible later only with a cited per-area dataset). Typed-neighborhood lookup skipped, sheet names too coarse (51 areas share 'South Chicago'); the top-of-page hook link delivers the intent.
decisions.validation: Gate 1 static render blind test: skeptic 'serious museum evidence', curator 'yes, I'd floor this', fresh visitor would share it. Live-page check flagged only dev-mode screenshot artifacts. Suite grew to 151 checks / 15 scenarios, all green; turn-step recompute 81ms.
